answer: Replace free quorum counting with a bonded attestation trellis: every attester escrows a bond against the exact answer hash they countersign, recorded in the epoch atlas of seals, and a grader who confirms a bogus answer forfeits that bond when the appeal window closes. A Sybil farmer therefore needs one funded bond per clone per seat counted, so a lagoon of fake attestations drains the attacker's capital instead of the pool, while honest graders split the forfeits. Cost of one forged answer becomes k bonds plus the appeal fee, paid before any reward clears.
